configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Shared defaults inherited by all visible presets — not selectable directly

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Debug info, no optimization, asserts enabled — the default dev configuration

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: O3 + LTO, asserts disabled — use for performance measurements and shipping

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: Debug info + AddressSanitizer + UBSan — GCC and Clang only

configurePresets.name: ocl-cpu
configurePresets.description: Release build that forces OpenCL to execute on the CPU via PoCL — no discrete GPU required; primary CI path

configurePresets.name: ocl-gpu
configurePresets.description: Release build targeting a discrete GPU — requires a vendor OpenCL ICD installed on the system

buildPresets.name: ocl-gpu
buildPresets.description: Build targeting a discrete GPU runtime

testPresets.name: debug
testPresets.description: Run tests built under the debug preset

testPresets.name: ocl-cpu
testPresets.description: Run tests against the PoCL CPU runtime
